profile.headline: Full Stack Web Developer
profile.summary:
As a recent college graduate with a degree in Information Technology, I bring a unique blend of hands-on experience and academic knowledge to the field of web development. My journey began on the open road as a truck driver, where I honed my problem-solving skills, developed a strong work ethic, and learned the importance of meticulous planning and execution. 

During my time behind the wheel, I nurtured a growing passion for technology, which led me to pursue further education. Through my coursework and various projects, I have gained proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React, along with a solid understanding of back-end technologies like Node.js and SQL. My background as a truck driver has instilled in me a keen ability to work independently and manage time effectively, skills that are crucial in the fast-paced world of web development.

I am excited to bring my unique perspective and dedication to a team where I can contribute to creating innovative web solutions. Whether it's building responsive websites, optimizing user experiences, or tackling complex coding challenges, I am eager to leverage my diverse skill set to help drive success.

Let's connect and explore how my journey and skills can contribute to your next project.

projects.title: Freedom Homeschool
projects.description: Freedom Homeschool is a full stack web app built by homeschoolers for homeschoolers. This apps key features are hours tracking and transcript generator. This will simplify tracking students classes, hours and grades to ensure state compliance and easily create professional transcripts for college admissions.
